state.assistant: IT helpdesk assistant for employees. It calls one tool at a time.
state.user_request: Got a new phone over the weekend and now I can't get my sign-in codes, so I'm locked out of email.

recent_turns.text: Got a new phone over the weekend and now I can't get my sign-in codes, so I'm locked out of email.

next_tool.instructions: Which tool should the helpdesk assistant call next to handle state.user_request?

criteria.lookup_device: Look up an employee's laptop or phone record: model, OS, warranty, owner
criteria.reset_mfa: Clear the employee's two-factor devices so they can enroll a new or replaced phone
criteria.request_software: Ask for a software license or install, sent to the manager for approval
criteria.check_vpn_status: Check whether the VPN is up and whether the employee's last VPN sign-in failed
criteria.open_incident: Open an incident for an outage that affects many people, not one person
criteria.book_device_swap: Book an IT desk slot to swap a broken laptop or phone for a loaner
criteria.none: No tool is needed now: answer the employee directly
criteria.ask_user: The request does not say what the employee needs ("can you help"); ask them first
